instruction_reference: Current chat: account-retention options and recommended Option B schedule
scope: Selected engineering retention policy for actual account/linkage/reviewer metadata in the private synthetic demo; no clinical/statutory retention claim.
title: Reusable project accounts

supersedes.scope: Account-retention pending preference only. The independently reviewed EN/FR fallback-content item remains pending.

schedule.active_retention: Minimum necessary fields while approved project access remains justified.
schedule.exceptions: Retain only documented minimal attribution/recovery dependencies; do not retain the whole profile by default.

schedule.deprovisioning_action: Immediately disable access and revoke sessions.
schedule.secret_disposal: Clear raw tokens/verifiers when consumed, revoked or expired; the profile retention window does not extend credential validity or justify secret retention.

schedule.minimization: Exclude tokens, conversations and unnecessary identifiers.
Preserve necessary attribution without retaining the full account profile. Opaque IDs/hashes remain protected linkable metadata.

schedule.dependency_retention: Retain while an artifact or recovery obligation depends on the evidence.

schedule.retention: Minimum restriction until dependent grants and restorable copies are accounted for.
schedule.release: Reevaluate current dependencies and authorization before disposal; no indefinite unreviewed hold.

normal_profile_cleanup_path.qualification: Normal path without documented dependency/hold exceptions. This is not a universal bound on separately justified audit/review/restriction records or verified physical-erasure evidence.

remaining_requirements: Name accountable retention owner, purge operator and storage/backup custodians.
Inventory and classify real metadata across Keycloak, identity PostgreSQL, host help spool, publication/review records, exports/evidence and all copies/backups.
Implement bounded purge, immediate credential invalidation, dependency/hold exceptions and current restriction preservation.
Verify active-copy cleanup, copy/backup expiry and restoration without account/session/grant resurrection.
Bind actual implementation and evidence to the admission candidate before claiming retention acceptance.
